title: Release manifest schema field constraints for product_version, distribution_id, and toolchain_digest
limitations: Schema-only change; no runtime behavior modification.
Installer strict-mode validation was already stricter than JSON schema; this aligns the schema layer.
notes: Added minLength:1 maxLength:64 to product_version, minLength:1 to distribution_id, SHA-256 pattern to toolchain_digest. SPEC-0005 updated to document constraints matching installer strict-mode validation.
